official_splits.source: row membership of the HuggingFace parquet shards
official_splits.note: test_environment and test_genotype_environment contain only 2019 plots; test_plot is 'seen genotypes, seen environment, unseen plots'; test_genotype is unseen genotypes in seen environments.

custom_split.rule: within each ID year, genotypes are sorted, permuted with numpy RandomState(42), and assigned 80/10/10 to train/val/id_test; 2018 and 2022 are held out entirely

sample_definition.unit: one image pair from the same plot_uid
sample_definition.target_image: another inner_plot_images entry on date t_b
sample_definition.required: t_b > t_a; both images belong to the same plot_uid
sample_definition.span_pairs: for each span in {7,14,21,28,35,42} d, for each anchor image, choose the nearest later image with |Δt - span| <= 2 d; counts in reports/s1_split_statistics.json

weather_window.raw_records: hourly, 24 records per day, Sep 1 -> Aug 31
weather_window.missingness: 0 NaN in every checked year; identical across plots of a year
weather_window.left_join: daily aggregates are built in S2; S1 provides window bounds

label_matching.rule: for every image date, match the nearest measurement date of each trait; record the signed lag label_date - image_date
label_matching.validity_masks: downstream uses |lag| <= 3 d (strict) or <= 7 d (primary); the exact thresholds and counts are in reports/s1_label_timing.md
label_matching.missing_vs_zero: a trait is missing when there is no measurement date in the plot record; a measured 0 is kept as 0 and is never imputed

units.canopy_cover: raw 0-1 fraction (trait metadata says '%'; values are fractions)
units.weather: temperature degC, humidity %, irradiance W m-2, precipitation raw
